dataFolder.appDataDesc: Meesha fariimaha, moodooyinka la soo dejiyey iyo xogta kale lagu kaydiyo.

others.resetFactoryDesc: Soo celi app-ka xaaladdii asalka ahayd, adigoo tirtiraya dhammaan moodooyinka iyo taariikhda sheekada. Tallaabadani waa mid aan la celin karin waxaana lagula talinayaa oo kaliya haddii app-ku uu waxyeelloobay.

interface.title: Is-dhexgalka
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Meesha toast notifications ka soo muuqdaan. On Windows, default-ka waa bottom-right si popups uusan u daboolin kontoroolada daaqadda.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Tus tokens/ilbiriqsi iyo tirada tokens hoosta fariimaha kaaliyaha. Marka la damiyo, astaamo yar ayaa faahfaahinta muujinaya marka la gujiyo.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Isticmaal midabka accent-ka sidii asalka fariimahaaga. Marka la damiyo, waxay la mid noqon doonaan fariimaha kaaliyaha oo qoraal fudud ku yaal asalka caadiga ah.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Ku dar tabka Preview ee HTML iyo barnaamijyada koodhka SVG. HTML wuxuu ku ordiyaa bogga ay sameysay moodelka gudaha sanduuq xiran oo fulinaya skript-kiisa laakiin ma geli karo Novera, faylashaada, ama shabakadda; SVG waxay si joogto ah u soo bandhigtaa iyadoo skript-yadu deman yihiin. Asal ahaan waa daman.
interface.autoGenerateTitle: Si toos ah u abuuro cinwaanka sheekada
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Si toos ah u soo koob sheekooyinka cusub oo u beddel cinwaanka silsiladda. Daminta si loo haysto cinwaanka caadiga ah ilaa aad adigu u bixiso magac.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Deji midabka dambe ee daaqadda app-ka.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Deji midabka dambe ee aagga waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan.
interface.primaryDesc: Deji midabka ugu weyn ee astaamaha interface-ka.
interface.accentDesc: Xulo midabka astaanta ee guud ahaan UI-ga.
interface.destructiveDesc: Deji midabka muujinaya ficillada waxyeellada leh.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Dib u deji dhammaan dejimaha interface-ka sida caadiga ah.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccess: Interface si guul leh ayaa loo dib u dejiyay
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Dhammaan dejimaha interface-ka waa lagu soo celiyay sidii hore.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Dooro sida aragtida sheekada ay u dhaqmi doonto marka farriimo cusub yimaadaan.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Waxay aragtida ku xidhan tahay farriinta ugu dambeysa ee aad dirtay.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Si otomaatig ah ayay ula socotaa jawaabaha marka ay waqtiga dhabta ah ku dhacayaan.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Muuji tirinta token-ka gudaha galinta sheekada. Marka la naafoobo, tirinta token-ka waxay ka muuqataa hoosta galinta.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Tirinta xariiqaha ku muuji qaybaha koodhka.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyle: Dib u Dejinta Qaabka Qaybta Koodhka
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Dib ugu celi qaabka qaybta koodhka sidii kii asaliga ahaa.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Qaabka qaybta koodhku si guul leh ayuu u dib loo dejiyey
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Qaabka qaybta koodhka waxaa dib loogu celiyey asalka.

hardware.name: Magac
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Isticmaal Vulkan API si loo dardar-geliyo GPU. Ha u shidin Vulkan haddii aad haysato NVIDIA GPU maadaama laga yaabo inay dhibaatooyin la jaanqaadid keento.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: GPU-yada lama arki karo engine-ka llama.cpp. Moodooyinka waxay ku shaqeyn doonaan CPU.
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU wuxuu la wadaagaa hal keyd xusuus ah CPU — moodooyinka waxay isticmaalayaan isla xusuusta nidaamka intiisa kale.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: GPU-yadaada way is badaleen, sidaas darteed engine-ka gudaha waa la bilaabay. Moodooyinka waa la soo dejin doonaa marka la isticmaalo xiga.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: GPU-yadaadu way is badaleen, laakiin model ayaa mashquul ah. Jooji kadibna riix Cusboonaysii si aad u isticmaasho GPU cusub.

httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Aqoonsiyada server-ka wakiilka, haddii loo baahdo.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Liiska martida ee kala soocan oo lagu baajinayo wakiilka.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Ogolow shahaadooyinka iskii loo saxeexay ama aan la xaqiijin. Tani waxay lagama maarmaan u noqon kartaa qaar ka mid ah wakiillada laakiin waxay hoos u dhigeysaa amniga. Kaliya dhaqaaji haddii aad ku kalsoon tahay wakiilkaaga.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Hubi shahaadada SSL marka aad ku xidhayso wakiilka.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Hubi shahaadada SSL ee martida wakiilka.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Hubi shahaadooyinka SSL ee xiriirrada peer.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Xaqiiji shahaadooyinka SSL ee martida loo socdo.

webSearch.title: Raadinta Webka
webSearch.description: U ogolow moodooyinka inay baaraan oo akhriyaan webka iyagoo adeegsanaya qalabka gudaha Novera.
webSearch.enableDesc: Xayeysiin qalabka web_search iyo web_fetch moodooyinka taageera isticmaalka qalabka. Waxay ka shaqeysaa sanduuqa iyadoo aan lahayn furaha API.
webSearch.providerDesc: Dooro backend-ka jawaabaya web_search iyo web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Ikhtiyaari. Bixi furaha {{provider}} API si aad u hesho xad heer sare iyo natiijooyin nidaamsan. Ka tag furaha si aad u isticmaasho dhamaadka furaha aan furaha lahayn.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Loo baahan yahay. {{provider}} waxay u baahan tahay furaha API si loo soo celiyo natiijooyinka.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Loo baahan yahay. Saldhigga URL ee {{provider}}-gaaga, iyadoo JSON API la hawlgeliyo.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Deji dusha wakiilka Cowork: qolkiisa sanduuqa, iyo sidoo kale xusuusta iyo xirfadaha si joogto ah loogu hayo galkaaga xogta ee Novera.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Amarka waxaa ku socon jiray xaddidan ee {{backend}}: waxay kaliya qori karaan gudaha goob shaqo ee session-ka, faylasha ku jira galkaaga guriga ma akhrisan karaan.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Ma jiraan sanduuq gudaha nidaamkan, sidaa darteed qalabka shell laguma bixiyo. Amarka weligood kama soconayaan meel aan xadidneyn.
cowork.networkDesc: U oggolow amarrada Cowork inay gaaraan shabakadda, sida rakibidda baakadaha ama soo qaadista bakhaarka. Waxa ay default ahaan shidan yihiin. Shell-ka chat-ka ugu weyn mar walba shabakadda ma gelin karo.
cowork.noMemories: Ma jiraan xusuusyo weli. Moodooyinka waxay ku daraan iyaga qalabka memory_write marka ay bartaan waxyaabo mudan in la xafido.
cowork.noSkills: Xirfado ma jiraan weli. Xirfad waa hab la isku celin karo oo tilmaamo ah oo moodelku ka dalban karo marka loo baahdo.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Hal mowduuc oo qoraal kasta ah. Moodeladu waxay dib u akhriyaan iyadan iyadoo la adeegsanayo qalabka memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Tilmaamaha Markdown, ikhtiyaar ahaan leh sharaxaad ku jirta YAML frontmatter. Sharaxaadda waa waxa moodeladu arkaan ka hor inta aysan xirfadda gelin.
cowork.loadFailed: Lama awoodo in la geliyo goobta shaqada ee wakiilka
cowork.deleteFailed: Lama awoodo in la tirtiri karo
cowork.revealFailed: Lama awoodo in la furo galka

localApiServer.title: Adeegaha API Maxaliga ah
localApiServer.description: Ka socodsii server ku habboon OpenAI meel deegaanka ah.
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Fiiri diiwaanada faahfaahsan ee server-ka API ee deegaanka.
localApiServer.swaggerDocsDesc: Fiiri dukumentiyada is-dhexgalka ah ee API (Swagger UI).
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Si toos ah u bilow Server-ka Local API marka barnaamijku bilaabo.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Ka dhigo server-ka inuu ka sii shaqeeyo system tray marka daaqadda la xirayo. Marka la damiyo, xiritaanka daaqadda waxay joojisaa Novera iyo server-ka.
localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Xaqiiji codsiyada adoo isticmaalaya furaha API.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Martida loo oggol yahay inay galaan server-ka, oo lagu kala saaray faafin (commas).
localApiServer.corsDesc: U ogolow codsiyada isha kala fog inay galaan server-ka API.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: U ogolow server-ka inuu diiwaan geliyo xog faahfaahsan si loo dayactiro.
localApiServer.proxyTimeout: Codsiga wuxuu dhaafay waqtiga la sugayo
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Waqtiga la sugayo jawaabta moodelka gudaha, ilbiriqsiyo.
localApiServer.defaultModel: Moodelka Caadiga ah ee gudaha Server-ka API
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Moodelka gudaha ee si toos ah loo raro marka server-ku bilaabmo.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Si aad nooga caawiso horumarinta Novera, waxaad la wadaagi kartaa xog aan la aqoonsan karin sida isticmaalka astaamaha iyo tirada isticmaaleyaasha. Waligaa ma uruurino sheekaysigaaga ama macluumaadkaaga shaqsiyadeed.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Waxaad si buuxda u xakameyn kartaa xogtaada. Wax dheeri ah ka baro Siyaasadda Asturnaanta.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Si aan u horumarino Novera, waxaan u baahanahay inaan fahanno sida loo isticmaalo—laakiin kaliya adiga oo naga caawinaya. Waxaad bedeli kartaa dejintaan wakhti kasta.
privacy.privacyPromises: Doorashadaada halkan ma beddeli doonto ballanqaynteena aasaasiga ah ee asturnaanta:
privacy.promise1: Wadahadalladaadu waa astaan waxayna ku jiraan qalabkaaga
privacy.promise2: Marna ma uruurinno macluumaadkaaga shaqsiga ah ama waxyaabaha sheekada
privacy.promise3: Dhamaan wadaagga xogta waa mid aan la aqoonsan karin oo isku dhafan
privacy.promise4: Waad ka bixi kartaa wakhti kasta adigoon lumin shaqeynta
privacy.promise5: Waxaan caddeynaa waxa aan uruurinno iyo sababta

attachments.subtitle: Qaabee lifaaqyada dukumiintiyada, xaddidaadda cabbirka, iyo habka soo celinta.
attachments.enableDesc: U oggolow gelinta iyo index-gareynta dukumiintiyada si loo soo celiyo.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Dooro sida dukumiintiyada la falanqeeyay loogu daro wada sheekaysiga.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Qayb ka mid ah macnaha moodelka oo loo isticmaalo goynta faylasha la baaray ee moodelada maxaliga ah.
attachments.maxFileDisabledReason: Dami Enable Attachments si aad u bedesho xadka cabbirka dukumeentiga.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Cabbirka ugu badan dukumeenti kasta. Waxaa lagu dabaqaa marka la soo raro iyo marka la farsameeyo. Sawirrada waxay leeyihiin xaddigooda kore.
attachments.maxImageDesc: Cabbirka ugu badan sawir kasta (JPEG ama PNG). Bixiyahaaga ama moodelkaaga wuxuu yaabaa inuu qaado xad hoose.
attachments.topKDesc: Tixraacyada ugu badan ee la soo celinayo.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Qiyaasta isku ekaanshaha ugu yar (0-1). Kaliya waxaa loo isticmaalaa raadinta cosine tooska ah, ANN ma aha.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Dooro inta u dhaxaysa sqlite-vec ANN, linear cosine, ama auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Tirada ugu badan ee shakhsiyad kasta oo qayb loogu talagalay embeddings.
attachments.chunkOverlapDesc: Isku-darka shakhsiyada ee u dhexeeya qaybaha isku xiga.

changeDataFolder.title: Beddel Goobta Faylka Xogta
changeDataFolder.description: Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad beddesho goobta galka xogta? Tani waxay u dhaqaaqi doontaa dhammaan xogtaada goobta cusub waxayna dib u bilaabi doontaa barnaamijka.
